requirements.verifier_assertion: Program at /app/solution.py, invoked as `python solution.py --input /app/inputs/data --output /app/result.json`. Reads every *.json file inside --input.
Tool must run using Python standard library only; no third-party packages; no network.
Each record has id, type ("scramble"|"facelet"), state, optional priority (default 0 when absent).
must_include: priority as 0 when the field is absent

requirements.verifier_assertion: Scramble state is a space-separated move string; applying to solved reaches target; depth ≤ 8 for scramble records.
Facelet state is a 54-character string over U R F D L B, face order U/R/F/D/L/B, row-major; may lie ≥12 moves from solved.
must_include: U R F D L B

requirements.verifier_assertion: Singmaster moves: face in U D L R F B; no suffix = CW quarter, ' = CCW quarter, 2 = half; anything else illegal.
must_include: U D L R F B

requirements.verifier_assertion: Solved state facelet string = UUUUUUUUURRRRRRRRRFFFFFFFFFDDDDDDDDDLLLLLLLLLBBBBBBBBB (verifier's SOLVED constant).
Solvable entry: {"id", "moves": [...], "solved": true}; applying moves to target yields SOLVED; already-solved input yields "moves": []; any legal sequence accepted.
Invalid entry: {"id", "error": <reason>} with no "moves"; process still exits 0 with invalid records present.
Facelet invalid if not 54 chars, or contains char outside URFDLB, or does not have each letter count exactly 9.
must_include: outside the set U R F D L B
each of the six letters exactly 9 times

requirements.verifier_assertion: Scramble invalid if any token is not a legal Singmaster move.
Dedup: highest priority wins; tie -> file whose name sorts last; still tie -> later array index. Only surviving record is solved and reported.
/app/result.json is a JSON array; one object per unique id; sorted by id in ascending lexicographic order.
must_include: sorted by id in ascending lexicographic order

requirements.verifier_assertion: Byte-identical output on repeated runs; explicit ordering in move search / state traversal / serialization; no hash/set iteration order; no random.
